Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3216: tests/ui/ffi_boundary_evidence.stderr.

Error [E3216]: Foreign boundary evidence is invalid for foreign function `invalid`.
  --> tests/ui/ffi_boundary_evidence.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     fn invalid() Int = "invalid"
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Generated foreign functions must retain the descriptor-owned effect root; this declaration reports `FFI.Fortran`.
 Fix: Preserve the descriptor-owned `FFI` effect root.
